s1.syndrome_frame: subacute back pain with a retroperitoneal mass
salient_findings: dull, nonradiating back pain for two months
5 cm lesion in the left retroperitoneal space on lumbar MRI
heterogeneous enhancement on contrast-enhanced abdominal CT
key_facts: 36-year-old man
two-month history of back pain
denies urinary symptoms, limb weakness, or sensory changes
unremarkable medical history, physical examination, and laboratory studies
lesion located adjacent to the iliopsoas muscle
low signal intensity on T1-weighted images and high signal intensity on T2-weighted images on MRI
mass abuts the left ureter and left common iliac artery
fluorodeoxyglucose avidity with an SUVmax of 5.2 on PET-CT
brain and chest CT scans were normal

shortlist.label: Liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Retroperitoneal location and imaging characteristics are consistent with liposarcoma

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Retroperitoneal location and heterogeneous enhancement on CT are consistent with leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Retroperitoneal lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Retroperitoneal location and fluorodeoxyglucose avidity on PET-CT are consistent with lymphoma

shortlist.label: Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Retroperitoneal location and imaging characteristics are consistent with sarcoma, although this is a broader category

shortlist.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Retroperitoneal location and imaging characteristics are consistent with solitary fibrous tumor, a rare but possible diagnosis

raw.rationale: The lesion's location in the retroperitoneal space, its appearance on MRI with low signal intensity on T1-weighted images and high signal intensity on T2-weighted images, and its heterogeneous enhancement on CT are consistent with liposarcoma. Additionally, the fluorodeoxyglucose avidity with an SUVmax of 5.2 on PET-CT supports a malignant diagnosis like liposarcoma.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Less common in the retroperitoneal space and typically has a more homogeneous appearance on imaging

rejected.label: Retroperitoneal lymphoma
rejected.why: Typically has a more aggressive appearance on imaging and is often associated with systemic symptoms or lymphadenopathy

rejected.label: Sarcoma
rejected.why: Too broad of a category, as sarcoma encompasses many subtypes including liposarcoma

rejected.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
rejected.why: Typically has a more benign appearance on imaging and is less likely to demonstrate fluorodeoxyglucose avidity
